source_binding.qualification: Version-matched source; not asserted byte-identical to accepted package. LFS pointers are not payload inspection.

method.bounded_selection: Twelve distinct remaining terrain GUIDs whose observed names suggest composite structures, interactions, navigation helpers or NPCs. Names select candidates only; GUID equality decides identity.
method.git_blob_integrity: All 35 fetched metadata/asset texts UTF-8 encoded and checked using SHA1(b'blob '+decimal_byte_length+b'\0'+bytes); all match exact Git tree blob SHAs.
method.terrain_group_extraction: Split Unity YAML at document headers; for class ID 1001, group by m_SourcePrefab GUID and collect serialized m_Name property overrides. Overrides may name descendants, not necessarily only roots.
